fieldMarks: Silky grey and cinnamon-brown fur; belly hairs are white-tipped with grey bases
Furred gliding membrane runs from foreleg wrist to hindleg ankle; long flattened tail
Large black eyes; 75-140 g, 275-342 mm total length
Larger than the southern flying squirrel
behavior: Strictly nocturnal, active roughly 2 hours after sunset and before sunrise
Glides between trees but is clumsy on the ground
Up to 8 may share a nest; sexes aggregate in winter for warmth
Diet leans heavily on lichens and fungi, plus nuts, acorns, buds, sap; calls are soft chirps and clucks
habitat: Conifer-dominated forest, also deciduous and mixed forest. Nests 1-18 m up in trees of twigs, bark, feathers and fur.
range: Alaska and Canada south to northern California, Colorado, Michigan, Wisconsin, North Carolina and Tennessee, with isolated high-elevation populations.

lookalikes.name: Southern flying squirrel
lookalikes.howToTell: Smaller, with cream-coloured rather than grey-based belly fur.
